description: Substring or regex search over indexed symbol names (unlike find_symbol, which is exact-match only). Optional kind/path filters. Hard-capped at 50 hits.

limit.description: Maximum hits to return (default 50, hard max 50).

path.description: Workspace-relative file to restrict the search to.

pattern.description: Substring to match (case-insensitive), or RegExp source when regex is true.

regex.description: Treat pattern as a JavaScript RegExp source. Default false (substring).

name: search_symbols
title: Search symbols
